title: Rudolf Blaschka 1892 — specimen/model divergence, dispatch and circulation-value crosswalk

article_mechanism: Transport coupled a split workshop by converting plants and models into handleable, insurable, certifiable and countable units. A field reference could diverge into durable descendants retained in different media and repositories; later shipments selectively reaggregated only some descendants and production outputs.

dispatch_clock_evidence.finding: Models were substantially ready but shipment date remained uncertain because mounting remained and packing boxes had to be ordered at the last moment; timing depended on the crate maker and could shift one or two weeks.
Most models were fixed on glass panes because otherwise the fragile objects could not be handled.
dispatch_clock_evidence.mechanism: support architecture creates a handleable transport state

shipment_size_negotiation.finding: Goodale proposes authorizing 30 or 40 models for the next January instalment after summer-shipment delay suggests the Blaschkas are beyond their strength.
Blaschkas thank Goodale/Wares for permission to reduce next shipment count and explain that some American specimens take weeks, delaying shipment until the specified number is complete.

harvard_defrays: expenses from place of manufacture to Cambridge

august_1894_workshop_account.interpretive_guard: Do not equate notebook total with contractual salary or sale price until matching Harvard invoice/source genre is identified.

january_1894_workshop_account.guard: OCR misses/obscures at least one charge; do not force reconstruction of the 160-mark difference from text alone.

receiving_cost_layer.finding: Goodale reports Snow's bill for commission and expenses on importation and subsequent official passage/release of the cases.

research_claims: A field plant could generate multiple durable descendants that remained in different repositories/media.
Finished representation and dispatchable freight are distinct object states.
Packing/support made fragile models handleable, not merely safer.
Shipment count linked material difficulty, labour capacity and institutional scheduling and could be renegotiated.
Circulation costs and administrative certification were explicitly itemized apart from model value in workshop accounting.
A shipment aggregated objects while masking differences in production date, maker, reference lineage and circulation cost.
